verdict.rationale: Floot hosts apps on a managed Postgres database, so choosing a data region is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a region or residency selector, or any documented data-location guarantee. Exporting the code and database to self-host elsewhere is a user-side workaround and an adjacent capability, so it earns no credit for in-product residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
